name: complaint-database
description: Read complaint records and update their status in the local PostgreSQL complaint database.

tools.name: get_complaint_by_id
tools.description: Get the latest record for one complaint ID.

tools.name: search_complaints
tools.description: Search current complaint records using status, severity, owner, region, customer, service, category, and channel filters.

tools.name: list_recent_complaints
tools.description: List the newest current complaint records.

tools.name: get_customer_complaint_history
tools.description: List recent complaint records for a customer.

tools.name: update_complaint_status
tools.description: Update the status of a complaint.

tools.name: assign_complaint
tools.description: Assign a complaint to a support owner.
